communication_goal: 用最小改动验证假设，避免大范围修改掩盖原因。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE polished educational scene illustration, square canvas approximately 1024x1024. Pure solid BLACK background with crisp clean WHITE line art only. Minimalist adult stick-figure programmer with circular head, thin limbs and simple expressive face. The programmer is conversing with a recognizable official OpenAI six-loop interwoven knot logo floating nearby, drawn in white with black negative spaces; the logo itself represents the AI conversational partner and has no human body. EXACTLY ONE human programmer and ONE OpenAI logo. Single coherent scene, no panels. Restrained programmer comic aesthetic. Keep the main scene approximately x=180..820 and y=230..770 on a 0..1000 canvas. Leave generous empty black space at the top y<200 and bottom y>820 for later learning labels. Props named in the scene must be recognizable, complete and unobstructed. No colored elements, gradients, gray shading, photorealism, textures, glow. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, readable code, captions, watermark or other logos. The only brand symbol is the requested OpenAI knot. Scene: The adult stick-figure programmer kneels at the left of a small simple device box on a low table. One single detachable cable lies fully visible at center, with both connector ends complete and separated from the device. The programmer points toward the cable without touching it. The floating white OpenAI knot is at the right. No other cables, labels, ports with letters, tools or screens.

image_review.summary: 通过：单幅黑底白线插画，一个成年火柴人和一个 OpenAI 标识。桌面上唯一断开的连接线及两端插头清晰可见；隔离、根因和补丁属于调试语境，不给虚假框。
